sections.title: Afternoon tea at Bentley Hotel
sections.html:
Afternoon tea has been a British habit since the 1840s, so the story goes, when dinner moved later and something was needed to fill the gap. The form hasn’t changed much since: finger sandwiches, scones with cream and jam, a few small cakes and a proper pot of tea, eaten slowly in the middle of the afternoon with people you like.

We serve it in the conservatory, the purpose-built glass room on the side of the house, which suits exactly this kind of unhurried sitting. It is laid by arrangement rather than every day, so we ask you to book ahead and tell us your numbers. The sandwiches, scones and cakes come from our own kitchen. What goes on the stand, and the price, are confirmed when you book, and we can add a glass of fizz, a birthday cake with candles, or a savoury tier for anyone who isn’t a cake person.

Afternoon tea suits the occasions that don’t need an evening: a birthday with the grandparents, a baby shower, a retirement, a christening after the service, a hen afternoon before the hen night, or a get-together of old friends. The conservatory takes smaller parties; for a crowd, the function suite seats up to 100 and can be dressed for the occasion. If anyone is travelling, our 18 en-suite rooms are here, parking is free and Motherwell station is about 5 minutes’ walk.

sections.title: The room, the tea and the night after

items.title: The conservatory
items.text: Our purpose-built conservatory is bright, warm and unhurried, with the restaurant beside it. For a larger party, the function suite seats up to 100 and can be dressed for the occasion.

items.title: The tea
items.text: Sandwiches, scones and cakes from our own kitchen, with tea or coffee and a glass of fizz if you'd like one. What goes on the stand, and the price, are confirmed when you book.

items.title: Stay the night
items.text: If family are travelling for the occasion, our 18 en-suite rooms are here, with breakfast cooked to order. Check-in from 2pm, check-out by 11am.

sections.title: Afternoon tea: what people ask us

items.q: How do we book afternoon tea?
items.a: Afternoon tea is served by arrangement, so please book ahead. Call us on 01698 265588 or send an enquiry with your date, your numbers and the occasion, and we’ll confirm what we can do and the price.

items.q: Do we need to pay a deposit?
items.a: Sometimes, for larger parties. If a deposit is needed we’ll say how much and when it is due, and explain our cancellation terms, when you book.

items.q: Can you cater for dietary requirements?
items.a: Yes. Tell us about allergies, intolerances and gluten-free, vegetarian or vegan guests when you book and the kitchen will bake with them in mind. Children are welcome; ask us about a smaller stand for them.

items.q: Is there parking, and can we come by train?
items.a: Parking at the hotel is free, and Motherwell station, about 5 minutes’ walk away, has trains from Glasgow Central in under 20 minutes at the fastest. Relatives travelling for the occasion can book a room.

sections.title: Book an afternoon tea
sections.text: Tell us the date, the numbers and the occasion, and we’ll lay the conservatory for you. Rooms for anyone staying can be booked online.
